chapter_note: This chapter is overwhelmingly substrate — the doctrine of the Three Times (chronoi/kairoi) is one of the foundational cosmological structures: (1) from First Man's descent to his ascent, (2) from his ascent until the Ambassador reveals his image, (3) from that revelation until Panaretos (the Extraction) ascends and the cosmos dissolves. The teaching is impersonal, structural, and stays entirely within the cosmic system. Editorial frame is minimal: the chapter title (segs 0–2), one Apostle-formula at the opening (seg 3), and one disciple-question hinge (segs 48, 57). The disciples' question about durations (segs 57ff) is substantive cosmological content — preserved as substrate. Heavy manuscript damage (83.9%) but the visible material is consistently substrate. Negative editorial fatigue (-0.49) confirms substrate dominance throughout.
